why: Fix round for the five faults of review 1 of ticket 1161, in today's tooling (.github/, CI serving both versions). After the merge of origin/main (279f97ee0), SC21's read check reads every form of the inputs (a bracket index as a dot, a whole github or github.event as bare name, .* or index, in any case), SC17 holds SCOPE and LAW to exactly the ${{ inputs.scope }} and ${{ inputs.law }} expressions, the law input's description has its plant, P6, P8 to P11 and S9 are it.prop with Schema generators and no seed, and the hand start's values are called inputs (Inputs, inputsOf, the inputs field and record key) in place of ask. proof.test.ts 21 and scheduled.test.ts 313 green with CI=1; pnpm format, pnpm lint, the list ratchet and one pnpm typecheck passed.
note: Started time is approximate; usage and cost are not recorded. Model and effort are the requested values. This container has Node 22 where the pin is Node 26, so the two law files ran with CI=1. botpush.mjs cannot read its key here, so each stepcommit.sh push was refused after the commit and a plain git push was used. The merge of origin/main auto-merged to a proof.ts with two bindings named asked (main's listings and our inputsOf); fixed in the merge commit by naming main's reach. The first pnpm typecheck failed on two test lines (Schema.Struct with a _tag, tsgo schemaStructWithTag); the generator now uses Schema.TaggedStruct and the second pnpm typecheck passed. The P12 type law plant ran through one narrow tsc over .github/ci. The coverage checks of the new it.prop laws run in each file's one afterAll, since the vitest/no-duplicate-hooks rule allows one.
